function.name: yuvomi_mcp__add_shopping_item
function.description: Add to one list using current Yuvomi state. Preserve exact products and existing categories. Supply a valid category on the first call for every new item. Open items add compatible quantities, otherwise replace transparently; checked items reactivate with new quantity. Use operation=note for note-only edits. Report actual outcomes; never retry uncertain writes.

name.description: Exact product/brand; no synonyms, partial matches or substitution.

quantity.description: Free text (e.g. 2 Tuben). Omitted: +1 current unit if known for open items, otherwise 1. Open: add compatible amounts, otherwise replace. Checked: set new quantity. set is absolute.

category.description: NEW items: exact valid category on first call; read categories unless known. Never invent one; Sonstiges only if none fits. Existing category wins.

operation.description: ensure/increase: add or transparently replace unsafe amounts, create/reactivate. set: absolute; quantity required. note: existing note only, no quantity/category or status change.

note.description: Optional Unicode note; omit to preserve, even on reactivation. Default append; replace only explicitly.

note_mode.description: append default; replace/clear only explicitly. clear without note. Note-only: operation=note, no quantity/category.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__add_shopping_items
function.description: Process 1–20 items on one list; category belongs in each new items[] object. Add to one list using current Yuvomi state. Preserve exact products and existing categories. Supply a valid category on the first call for every new item. Open items add compatible quantities, otherwise replace transparently; checked items reactivate with new quantity. Use operation=note for note-only edits. Report actual outcomes; never retry uncertain writes.

name.description: Exact product/brand; no synonyms, partial matches or substitution.

quantity.description: Free text (e.g. 2 Tuben). Omitted: +1 current unit if known for open items, otherwise 1. Open: add compatible amounts, otherwise replace. Checked: set new quantity. set is absolute.

category.description: NEW items: exact valid category on first call; read categories unless known. Never invent one; Sonstiges only if none fits. Existing category wins.

operation.description: ensure/increase: add or transparently replace unsafe amounts, create/reactivate. set: absolute; quantity required. note: existing note only, no quantity/category or status change.

note.description: Optional Unicode note; omit to preserve, even on reactivation. Default append; replace only explicitly.

note_mode.description: append default; replace/clear only explicitly. clear without note. Note-only: operation=note, no quantity/category.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__call_api_operation
function.description: Call a documented REST operation within token rights. Generic access requires existing explicit HA approval; never use it to bypass dedicated tools.

method.description: Method with path if no operation_key.

path.description: Path with method if no operation_key.

start_datetime.description: Required date or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Z/offset converts to household timezone; all-day uses the date.

all_day.description: Whether the event lasts all day.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__create_recipe
function.description: Create an exact recipe/menu variant as lunch, base servings 4 by default. Supply ingredients and known menu metadata; ask for unknown facts. Store justified health as an AI suggestion. Resten may have no ingredients. No image/link, scaling or shopping transfer. Requires meals:write and shopping:read for ingredient categories.

ingredients.description: Exact ingredients and free-text amounts for basisportionen; valid shopping categories only. [] explicitly empties ingredients; allowed for Resten.

notes.description: Recipe instructions; omit to preserve, default append. Metadata is separate.

zubereitungszeit_min.description: Total minutes from cooking start to serving, including baking/waiting.

gesundheit_begruendung.description: Justify the health score; AI suggestion, never human confirmation.

basisportionen.description: Recipe quantity basis; creation default 4. No automatic scaling.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__create_task
function.description: Create a family task with optional due date, priority and tags.

tags.description: Multiple free-form tags, separate from category; mirror CalDAV CATEGORIES.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__get_api_operation
function.description: Read one OpenAPI operation key. Existing explicit HA approval still required.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__get_recipe
function.description: Read one exact Yuvomi recipe ID; meals:read.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_api_operations
function.description: Discover token-authorized REST operations. Existing explicit HA approval still required.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_recipes
function.description: Read Yuvomi recipes/menus with ingredients, notes and metadata. No planning or shopping writes; meals:read.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_shopping_categories
function.description: Read current category names in Yuvomi order for new shopping items; never invent categories.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_shopping_items
function.description: List shopping items across lists; unchecked by default.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_tasks
function.description: List current top-level family tasks; open by default. Optional status and AND-tag filters.

status.description: Filter status; archived selects the separate archive regardless of stored status.

include_future.description: Include future-start tasks; excluded by default.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_upcoming_events
function.description: Read upcoming Yuvomi events from today.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__suggest_shopping_items
function.description: Search shopping suggestions by prefix. Similar names are different products; never reuse historical quantities.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__update_recipe
function.description: Edit one native recipe ID; omitted fields, notes, images and links stay. Notes append by default; replace/clear only explicitly. Metadata merges; changed health needs justification, changed base servings explicit ingredient quantities. Never edit provider mirrors. Requires meals:write; shopping:read for changed ingredients. Do not retry uncertain writes.

ingredients.description: Exact ingredients and free-text amounts for basisportionen; valid shopping categories only. [] explicitly empties ingredients; allowed for Resten.

notes.description: Recipe instructions; omit to preserve, default append. Metadata is separate.

zubereitungszeit_min.description: Total minutes from cooking start to serving, including baking/waiting.

gesundheit_begruendung.description: Justify the health score; AI suggestion, never human confirmation.

basisportionen.description: Recipe quantity basis; creation default 4. No automatic scaling.

notes_mode.description: Explicit replace/clear free text only; keep metadata. clear without notes.
